exposure: mode of delivery (elective cesarean, emergency cesarean, vaginal)
outcome: mother-infant bonding (using the Mother-to-Infant Bonding Scale)
cohort: Low-risk singleton pregnancies delivered at term (112 elective cesarean, 115 emergency cesarean, 107 vaginal delivery)
finding: Unplanned cesarean delivery was associated with a higher incidence of poor mother-infant bonding immediately after delivery and at 6 weeks postpartum compared to elective cesarean and vaginal delivery.
